title: Golem's Legacy
description: This mod adds new unusual golems made from various blocks to Minecraft.
body:
In this mod, I added five interesting golems. The Emerald Golem grants the Village Hero effect. The Gold Golem turns iron into gold. The Dirt Golem uses the bone meal effect underneath it. The Scarecrow is simply a new raider. To use the Glass Golem, you need to combine any potion and a stone in the brewing station, then click the resulting item on the golem.
